clauses.reason: Section 1(a)(i) as signed prohibits importation into the United States of the following products of Russian Federation origin: fish, seafood and preparations thereof; alcoholic beverages; non-industrial diamonds; and other products the Secretary of the Treasury determines in consultation with the Secretaries of State and of Commerce. Section 3(a) of Executive Order 14114 (December 22, 2023) struck this subsection and inserted a longer one covering importation and entry, including into a foreign trade zone, of those products (A) and of categories of such products wholly or partly produced in or harvested by the Russian Federation (B), products containing them (C), and products that transited through or were exported from the Russian Federation (D), as determined by the Secretaries; under the owner ruling on strike-and-insert amendments the clause continues, amended, and the substance of this subsection changed. The amendment by Executive Order 14114 took effect on signing, December 22, 2023 (the OFR note on the target prints December 12, 2023, which the held order text, signed December 22, 2023, contradicts). No held instrument revokes or supersedes this clause. The national emergency under which it acts (declared in Executive Order 14024) was continued by the Federal Register notices of April 13, 2022, April 7, 2023, April 9, 2024, April 10, 2025 and March 24, 2026; the last, dated March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15515), continues it beyond April 15, 2026 for 1 year, which covers 2026-10-14. The clause was therefore operative on 2026-10-14, as amended.

research_rationale:
Whole-lifecycle claim: the order was in force on 2026-10-14. Evidence: the held Federal Register text of the order read in full (every clause decided); the held texts that cite it by number, the OFR catalog edges and the bounded searches. The bounded searches were read for coverage: current-law:usc covers U.S. Code release point 119-121 (edition current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted after that date and on or before 2026-10-14 are not reflected), current-law:ecfr covers an eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, and later-events:ofr_catalog covers Office of the Federal Register disposition notes (checked 2026-11-25). The inventory in the packet held one clause covering only the preamble, so the inventory is corrected from the held Federal Register text (16 clauses). The order was amended by Executive Order 14114 (December 22, 2023).
